title: Euclid Accents
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: Euclid Accents, after the Analog Rytm mod: a Euclidean rhythm accents the trigs you already have instead of adding new ones. SETTINGS: ACC T1-T8 (OFF, 1-16 accents spread evenly over the track's length, the first step always one) and ACC DEPTH (0-64: accented trigs play DEPTH/2 louder, the rest DEPTH/2 softer). The pattern itself never changes. Settings are saved. Needs seq-events. Its rows sit in the MOD SETTINGS section when that mod is in the build.
